WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, v.order_id 
  FROM order_items oi 
  JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
),
seller_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS num_orders, 
    AVG(rv.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders
  FROM order_items oi 
  JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN order_reviews rv ON rv.order_id = v.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_ranking AS (
  SELECT 
    seller_id, 
    num_orders,
    avg_review_score,
    total_sales,
    late_orders,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY late_orders / num_orders DESC) AS late_rank
  FROM seller_stats
)
SELECT 
  seller_id, 
  num_orders, 
  avg_review_score, 
  total_sales, 
  late_orders
FROM seller_ranking
WHERE sales_rank <= 0.25 AND (avg_review_score < 3.5 OR late_rank <= 0.15)
